title: DexFLEX: Contact-Aware Foundation Controller for Command-Guided Dexterity
abstract: arXiv:2610.14372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dexterous robot hands can receive useful motion intent from teleoperation or learned policies, but successful execution also depends on contact decisions that these commands rarely specify. We introduce DexFLEX, a contact-aware foundation controller that turns upstream fingertip-motion drafts into contact-consistent joint commands. Instead of treating a draft as a trajectory to copy, DexFLEX treats it as evidence about intent: from the current tactile-proprioceptive state, it proposes feasible short-horizon motion chunks, predicts their contact consequences, and selects the candidate that best follows the command while preserving future contact stability. At inference time, a simple Draft-Dream-Select procedure combines pure-prior proposals for recovery with draft-seeded proposals for responsiveness, then decodes the selected motion into executable joint-space targets. translated_title: DexFLEX：面向指令引导灵巧操作的接触感知基础控制器
translated_abstract: 灵巧机器人手可以通过遥操作或学习到的策略接收有用的运动意图，但成功的执行还取决于这些指令很少明确规定的接触决策。我们提出了 DexFLEX，这是一种接触感知的基础控制器，能够将上游的指尖运动草案转化为接触一致的关节指令。DexFLEX 不是将草案视为需要复制的轨迹，而是将其作为意图的证据：基于当前的触觉-本体感知状态，它提出可行的短时程运动块，预测其接触后果，并选择最能遵循指令同时保持未来接触稳定性的候选方案。在推理阶段，一个简单的“草案-想象-选择”程序将用于恢复的纯先验提议与用于快速响应的草案种子提议相结合，然后将选定的运动解码为可执行的关节空间目标。在指令退化的仿真环境、真实世界共享控制以及……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 DexFLEX 接触感知基础控制器，将上游指尖运动草案视为意图证据而非待复制的轨迹，通过“草案-想象-选择”推理机制在触觉-本体感知状态下生成并筛选出既遵循指令又保持未来接触稳定性的关节指令。
en_tdlr: DexFLEX is a contact-aware foundation controller that treats upstream fingertip-motion drafts as evidence of intent rather than trajectories to copy, using a Draft-Dream-Select inference procedure to propose, predict contact consequences of, and select short-horizon motion chunks that best follow commands while preserving future contact stability.
